mathematics.assertion_tested: Finite rational examples on V29-V41 agree with supplied matrix, polynomial, Gaussian-moment, entropy-coefficient, survival and rational-calculus calculations; deliberately false alternatives are rejected.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational arithmetic via fractions.Fraction and integer polynomial coefficients; logarithmic identities compare symbolic coefficients only.
mathematics.conventions: Column probability vectors and left matrix multiplication; row exit kernels and explicitly ordered paths; each state/pole model is named in the checker.
non_claims: Does not establish arbitrary operator, continuum, uniform-time, integration, completeness or support-sensitive entropy theorems.
Overlap with inherited models is not additional independent coverage.
